name: Prion
short_description: Not a cell and not a virus — a misfolded protein (PrP^Sc) that templates PrP^C into β-sheet copies which stack into amyloid fibrils.

textbook.1: ✅ PASS — α-helix PrP^C → arrow → β-sheet PrP^Sc → ordered amyloid fibril; protein structure only, no text/cell/virus/DNA.

sem.1: ✅ PASS — fine elongated twisted amyloid fibrils only; no cell/capsid/text.

3d.1: ✅ PASS — α-helical PrP^C converting via an arrow into a stacked β-sheet amyloid fibril; protein structure only.

watercolor.1: ❌ FAIL — baked-in 'PrPC/PrPsc' text + a DNA-like double helix.
watercolor.2: ⚠️ content correct (α-helix → β-sheet stack) but a dark mat/frame around the paper.
watercolor.3: ✅ PASS — cream paper fills the frame (no mat); α-helix PrP^C → arrow → stacked β-sheet amyloid fibril; no text/DNA.
watercolor.4: ✅ PASS — re-rendered full-bleed on aged paper (no sheet/mat), cocci/rod style; α-helix PrP^C → arrow → stacked β-sheet amyloid fibril; no text/DNA.

reference: ✅ PASS — genuine NIAID negative-stain TEM of purified PrP amyloid fibrils (the aggregated misfolded prion protein), CC BY 2.0; colorized (warm amber fibrils on cool blue) for teaching consistency while preserving all fibril detail — no text/border/reinvented structures.
